source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful external reference to the open-access publication; all lesson explanations are original formulations and no text is imported or translated.
source_resources.selection_rationale: The original paper introducing jointly learned word feature vectors and the neural probabilistic language model; grounds the curriculum's embedding and MLP derivations in the primary literature.
source_resources.known_availability_limitations: Freely hosted on jmlr.org; no paywall.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Andrej Karpathy: Let's build makemore (MLP)
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Selected jointly: Makemore reproduces this architecture at character scale with MIT-licensed code; the paper supplies the original formalism and the n-gram comparison framing.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Jurafsky & Martin: Speech and Language Processing (3rd ed. draft), neural language models chapter
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Strong textbook coverage of n-grams through neural LMs; kept as secondary reading because the primary derivation follows the original paper's notation.

compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Foundational for embedding geometry but trains on context-prediction objectives rather than the full next-token probabilistic model studied this week; revisited in later representation blocks.
